Refusal beats --lane

An installer, .pkg/.dmg or hdiutil in argv is refused on every lane, no override;
--lane headless can't downgrade a GUI verdict. Nothing runs; the result is errored.
Source: src/cli/api.ts, src/router/index.ts
No fallback to your display

No Docker or helper session → skipped, exit 69, never your screen. The container
drops DISPLAY; sessiond checks peer uid and refuses input when on the console.

awaited request/reply; dotted (local) = file/IPC. A/B/C = workflows; equal step numbers = alternatives; unnumbered calls are independent.
Admission before queueing

POST /v1/tasks re-checks the caller after reading the body, then GUI
gate, capacity, credit; a repeated idempotency key replays. GET ?wait=
holds until the task ends.
Source: cloud/src/api/app.ts
Acknowledged is not yet durable

Writes are acked from memory; plane.json is rewritten atomically every
2 s if changed and on SIGTERM, so a crash can lose ~2 s of acked work.
Source: cloud/src/server.ts, cloud/src/core/persist.ts

text.text: How does a fleet box claim a task, run it in a slot, and wipe it?

Engineers onboarding to offstage and offstage cloud · Per-slot loops long-poll /claim, run work as the slot uid, report events and artifacts, then reset; a
separate heartbeat carries cancels.

Fleet runner

Key: frames = trust/deployment zones; box = runtime actor/process. Arrows: caller → recipient, response included; dashed (async) =
event/stream; dotted (local) = file/IPC; solid (sync) = awaited request/reply. A/B/C = workflows; equal step numbers = alternatives; unnumbered
calls are independent.
Claims, heartbeats, requeue

Claim long-polls ≤25 s. Unstarted 20 s after claim → requeue (max
3 tries); box silent 2 min → running task fails, not rerun. Heartbeat
(15 s) delivers cancels.
Source: cloud/src/core/queue.ts, cloud/src/core/store.ts
Guarded claim, reset before the next

A slot claims only while the pf LAN guard checks out (fails closed).
Before its next claim it is reset: processes killed, home wiped,
account remade with a new uid.
Source: src/fleet/lan-guard.ts, src/fleet/reset.ts

The key stays on the plane

The customer's Anthropic key stays in plane memory for one run; the slot gets an
omt_ token. The proxy checks model, step budget and max_tokens; no streaming.
Source: cloud/src/api/agent-routes.ts
Op relay and answer retries

Ops run concurrently as the slot user; each poll reports room. An answer is resent
with backoff until the plane takes it, and gets one try once closing.
Source: src/fleet/sandbox.ts
